description: This file declares functions for rendering 3D shapes in a graphics application, specifically for use with Lua scripting. It includes functions to draw a plane, box, sphere, cylinder, and torus, each accepting parameters that define their geometric properties. The file also contains detailed documentation and examples for each function.

methods.name: plane
methods.description: Function to draw a 2D plane with specified width and height, callable from Lua.

methods.name: box
methods.description: Function to draw a 3D box with provided width, height, and depth, callable from Lua.

methods.name: sphere
methods.description: Function to draw a 3D sphere with specified size and detail, callable from Lua.

methods.name: cylinder
methods.description: Function to draw a 3D cylinder with customizable parameters for radius, height, and detail, callable from Lua.

methods.name: torus
methods.description: Function to draw a 3D torus with specified radius, tube radius, and detail parameters, callable from Lua.
